solution_steps: Special Summon The Tricky by discarding Premature Burial.
Enter Battle Phase and attack Hibikime with UFO Turtle, then choose to bring Masked Dragon to the field.
Attack Hibikime with Masked Dragon and choose to bring back Element Dragon.
Attack Hibikime with Element Dragon, then choose to attack again.
